messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: lavaan 0.5-20 released on CRAN
parts:
Dear lavaan users,

lavaan 0.5-20 has been released on CRAN today (7 Nov 2015); this is
mostly just a small maintenance update, to anticipate the forthcoming
update of a few packages (blavaan, lavaan.survey and semTools), which
will depend on lavaan >= 0.5-20

Yves.
